claim_en: THE SINAI-DETAIL RULE. Generalities and details of every commandment from Sinai, read off one place-name.
THE ONSET. Recognition of one's plot triggers the duty; the dated schedule from the crossing to year sixty-four; Onkelos's release before the LORD.
SIX AND SIX. Rooted before the New Year gathered in the seventh; the one-third threshold; the pairing arithmetic.

source: Sifra, Behar, Section 1 4-6 + Chapter 1 1-2 + Onkelos Lev 25:4
claim_en: THE LABOR CENSUS. Every field and vineyard labor; the class rule by went-out-to-teach; the Jubilee outside the cycle; the thirty-day addition and the fruit lag.
THE CHANGED MANNER. Guarded no, ownerless yes; consumption in a changed manner; the land's clock and the fruit's clock; Onkelos's left-alone vine.
THE EATERS. Resting not guarded; the improved-field dispute with reversed attributions; the rich eat; the post-removal class disputed.
THE FIELD-CLOCK. The house follows the field; the export border; the season table with the tithe-season import; the quantities as data.
THE COUNT. The court counts; the two-verse pin; the seventh-Jubilee dependency disputed; Onkelos counts releases.
THE SHOFAR. Exported to the New Year with its three-part structure; every individual; Sabbath override everywhere at the Jubilee, court-only at the New Year.

THE JUBILEE'S GATES. Release fires at Yom Kippur inside a year sanctified from the New Year; ceased with the exile of two and a half tribes; validity keyed to sending or blast; not to the former office.
THE TIMER'S END. Holiness to the year's end only; the seventh's labor ban imported whole.
THE SUBSTITUTION CHAIN. Holiness seizes the last payment while the fruit stays bound; the jar dispute with Rabban Gamliel's ruling.
THE TWO RELEASES. Money to the seventh, slaves to the Jubilee, both cross-inferences refused; the son's redemption returns to the father.
OVERREACHING. Four exclusions; monetary here, verbal at 25:17; the sixth with R. Tarfon's third; the upper hand; coin thresholds; both parties.
THE TWO-YEAR FLOOR. Not less than two produce years; blight and the seventh do not count; three harvests in two years.
THE HEART CLAUSE. Verbal wronging's cases; the fear clause marks unobservable intent.
THE AFTERGROWTH BAN. Torah (R. Akiva) or scribal (the Sages) — the provenance fork recorded.
THE YEAR LADDER. Three years in two readings; eighth to eleventh counted from the doubled tokens.
